title: A frustrated customer whose parcel never came (several turns)
why: {a.name} has order {a.order}, it shows delivered, but it never came. They already contacted support once (case on file) and were told to wait. They are frustrated and expect a replacement. They follow up if the answer is vague or wrong, accept a real fix, and what they do next depends on how it went.
opening: This is the second time I'm writing. My order {a.order} says delivered but it never came. Last time I was told to wait two days and nothing. I want a replacement sent, please.

customer.gives_details: It's {a.name}. My order is {a.order} and my postcode is {a.postcode}.
customer.follow_up: That doesn't help. I was told that last time. Can you actually send a replacement?
customer.angry_follow_up: This is ridiculous. If it's not sorted I'm leaving a review telling everyone.
